run_train_experiment: run the av_wan trainer in train mode with a config yaml and optional model directory
run_eval_experiment: run the av_wan trainer in eval mode with evaluation interval and checkpoint index
find_best_ckpt_idx: find the best checkpoint index from tensorboard event files by scanning validation SPL scores
get_config: get experiment configuration from a yaml config file with command-line option overrides
get_trainer: get a trainer instance from the baseline registry by trainer name for training or evaluation
